server-turns.approval.cancelled: Waiting for the approval was cancelled
server-turns.background.endedRestart: The service restarted, so this background task ended (not rerun automatically)
server-turns.background.endedStop: The service stopped, so this background task ended (not rerun automatically)
server-turns.carry.alreadyThere: the conversation record is already in the new identity
server-turns.carry.copied: Switching identity: carried this conversation's record to the new identity ({n} file(s))
server-turns.carry.failed: Switching identity: {why}. This turn did not run; you can switch back to the original identity and go on
server-turns.carry.kept: The new identity's own record of this conversation differed from the old identity's; it was not discarded but kept in the new identity's configuration directory: {files}.
server-turns.carry.name: Identity switched
server-turns.carry.noOldDir: the old identity's configuration directory no longer exists on this node, so the conversation record cannot be carried over
server-turns.carry.notCarried: Switching identity: the conversation record could not be carried to the new identity
server-turns.carry.running: Switching identity: carrying this conversation's record to the new identity
server-turns.checkpoint.conflict: {n} file(s) were changed again after the AI changed them: {files}. To avoid overwriting those changes, neither the conversation nor the files were rewound. You can turn off "Also undo files" to rewind only the conversation, or deal with these files first and try again
server-turns.checkpoint.missing: Some of the {n} turn(s) to rewind have no {product} file snapshot ({why}), so the files cannot be fully rewound. To avoid undoing only part of it, neither the conversation nor the files were rewound. You can turn off "Also undo files" to rewind only the conversation
server-turns.checkpoint.missingWhy: turns before the feature was on, run on another device, before a fork, or snapshots pruned for capacity
server-turns.checkpoint.noCwd: The session's working directory does not exist: {cwd}
server-turns.checkpoint.tooBroad: The working directory is the home or root directory, too broad to snapshot files
server-turns.checkpoint.tooMany: The working directory has too many files (over {n}); no file snapshot
server-turns.checkpoint.unrestorable: {n} file(s) the AI changed cannot be restored: {files}. To avoid undoing only part of it, neither the conversation nor the files were rewound. You can turn off "Also undo files" to rewind only the conversation
server-turns.checkpoint.why.move-source: moved here from outside the working directory or from a nested repository; the original cannot be restored, so it cannot be deleted
server-turns.checkpoint.why.no-snapshot: not in the snapshot (for example, ignored by .gitignore)
server-turns.checkpoint.why.not-canonica: the path goes through a symbolic link or a case alias, so it cannot be confirmed it did not exist before
server-turns.checkpoint.why.unverifiable: cannot confirm it was not changed since
server-turns.claimed.agent: The AI started a new turn by itself
server-turns.config.changed: The configuration has changed; read it again before saving
server-turns.config.needManaged: Changing the configuration needs a separate identity signed in here; the host's existing configuration is view-only.
server-turns.config.notManaged: {short}'s configuration files are not managed by {product} (not supported); change them in {name}
server-turns.config.symlink: An identity's configuration is never written through a symbolic link
server-turns.config.tooLarge: The configuration file is over 200 KB
server-turns.dir.badChars: The directory path has invalid characters
server-turns.dir.beyond: The directory is beyond what this node may access
server-turns.dir.noAccess: No permission to access this directory
server-turns.dir.notDir: This path is not a folder
server-turns.dir.outside: The directory is outside what this node may access
server-turns.dir.tildeOnly: Only home paths starting with ~ or ~/ are supported
server-turns.dir.willCreate: The directory does not exist; it is created with the session
server-turns.drain.noNew: The service is about to restart to update: no new background commands / watches for now; try again in a few minutes
server-turns.drain.stopped: The service restarts to update: waited {minutes} min for background tasks that are still running; they were stopped (not rerun automatically)
server-turns.input.notReady: The Runner is not ready for this turn yet
server-turns.journal.capacity: The offline result journal reached its capacity; stopping this turn and keeping the evidence so far
server-turns.journal.chunkUnconfirmed: The recovered chunk was not confirmed
server-turns.journal.full: The offline result journal is over 100 MiB; restore the connection first
server-turns.journal.interrupted: The service restarted (the process was ended), so this turn was interrupted: the output so far is kept and nothing was replayed
server-turns.journal.unreadable: Cannot read the old result journal {file} ({error}); it was not imported. Check its permissions and start again.
server-turns.live.bgKeepaliveHours: Background commands ran unattended for over {n} h and ended as the session went offline
server-turns.live.bgKeepaliveMinutes: Background commands ran unattended for over {n} min and ended as the session went offline
server-turns.live.evicted: The number of AIs online at once is full; this one was idle longest with no background task running, so it went offline to free its slot (the history is kept; sending a message brings it back online)
server-turns.live.idleOffline: Idle for over {minutes} min with no background task or timer running; taken offline automatically
server-turns.live.otherIdentityBusy: The identity was switched, but the old identity's AI process is still running a turn: send again once it ends
server-turns.live.otherIdentityStuck: The identity was switched, but the old identity's AI process did not end in time: this turn did not run and the conversation record is untouched; send again later
server-turns.live.permissionChanged: This session's permission mode changed (skipping permission prompts is no longer allowed): the old AI process was stopped; please send again
server-turns.live.permissionWait: This session's AI process still runs background tasks in "skip permission prompts" mode: send again once they end (or take it offline in the session)
server-turns.live.restartFailed: Restarting the AI process failed: {error}; sending a message brings it back online
server-turns.live.restartNow: Restarted the AI process now as you asked, to apply the new auto-compaction threshold; the turn in progress was interrupted (the history is kept)
server-turns.live.restartedIdle: Restarted the AI process when idle to apply the new auto-compaction threshold ({threshold})
server-turns.live.restartedNow: Restarted the AI process now to apply the new auto-compaction threshold ({threshold})
server-turns.live.retire: Identity switched: the old identity's AI process ended once idle; the next message brings it online with the new identity (the history is kept)
server-turns.live.thresholdUpdated: The auto-compaction threshold was updated: the AI process ended; the next message brings it back online with the new threshold (the history is kept)
server-turns.live.unavailable: The session is unavailable; the process has ended
server-turns.login.cancelledOrExpired: The sign-in was cancelled or expired
server-turns.login.claudeUnconfirmed: The Claude subscription sign-in was not confirmed
server-turns.login.deviceCode: Enter the device code on the official page and authorize; this page updates by itself when that is done.
server-turns.login.done: The official CLI sign-in is done; you can choose this identity when creating a session.
server-turns.login.exited: The official sign-in process exited ({code}); try again or check the node's network.
server-turns.login.noChatgpt: No ChatGPT subscription identity was obtained
server-turns.login.notAuthorized: The official authorization was not completed
server-turns.login.pasteCode: Open the official authorization page; when done, paste the code it shows below.
server-turns.node.revoked: The control plane refused this node ({error}): the node was revoked. The Runner stops and takes no new work.
server-turns.op.acpNoFork: {short}'s ACP cannot fork (initialize does not declare session/fork)
server-turns.op.acpNoPlugins: {short}'s ACP does not expose plugin management; use Skills or MCP, or manage plugins in the native CLI / {short} settings
server-turns.op.acpNoUndo: This {short} ACP does not expose undo; use /undo in the native CLI
server-turns.op.filesRestoredAnyway: (note: the conversation was not rewound, but {n} file(s) were restored to before this message)
server-turns.op.mcpNotObject: The MCP configuration must be a JSON object
server-turns.op.noModelTools: Management operations run no model tools
server-turns.op.noToolRequests: This management operation takes no tool execution requests
server-turns.op.profileChanged: The identity's configuration changed; taken offline so it reloads
server-turns.op.profileChanging: The identity's configuration is about to change; ending the old process first
server-turns.op.rewindOffline: The AI still has background tasks or timers: taking the process offline before rewinding (not rewinding live)
server-turns.op.unsupported: This agent does not expose that operation; use the native CLI
server-turns.output.incomplete: This turn's output did not fully arrive; check it and recover; the agent's work was not replayed automatically
server-turns.quota.apiKey: An API key identity is billed by usage and has no plan quota
server-turns.quota.badBaseUrl: the identity's Base URL is invalid
server-turns.quota.claudeNone: Claude Code reports no plan quota data for this identity
server-turns.quota.codexNoWindows: Codex reported no 5-hour or weekly quota window
server-turns.quota.codexNotYet: Codex has not returned quota data yet (for a ChatGPT sign-in it shows after Codex starts or the next turn)
server-turns.quota.glmNoWindows: GLM returned no 5-hour or weekly quota window
server-turns.quota.glmNotYet: The GLM quota has not been read yet: it shows once this identity starts a conversation
server-turns.quota.noKey: the identity has no API key
server-turns.quota.notObject: the answer is not a JSON object
server-turns.readOnly.noOps: A read-only session only analyzes and compacts the context; run native commands in a shared-edit or isolated-development session
server-turns.resident.denied: The resident agent's setting: what auto mode still asks a person about is declined automatically; declined "{title}"
server-turns.resident.noDecline: The resident agent declines what needs a person's confirmation automatically: this request has no option to decline, so the turn was stopped
server-turns.resident.overLimit: This turn went over the resident agent's per-turn limit ({minutes} min) and was stopped
server-turns.restart.idle: The AI service restarted as you asked (when idle). The history is kept; sending a message brings it back online
server-turns.restart.now: The AI service restarted now as you asked; work in progress was interrupted. The history is kept; sending a message brings it back online
server-turns.restart.updated: The AI service updated itself to the new version (restarted when idle). The history is kept; sending a message brings it back online
server-turns.rewind.codexNotListed: This turn is not in Codex's list of turns, so which turns' files to rewind cannot be confirmed. To avoid undoing only part of it, neither the conversation nor the files were rewound. You can turn off "Also undo files" to rewind only the conversation
server-turns.rewind.messageNotFound: This message is not in the native session, so it cannot be rewound to exactly; /rewind can rewind by a number of turns
server-turns.rewind.tooMany: More turns to rewind than the native history has
server-turns.shell.dropped: … (about {n} characters left out in the middle) …
server-turns.shell.noCwd: The working directory does not exist
server-turns.sidecar.answered: Answered from the main context (not added to the main history; the main session was not interrupted)
server-turns.sidecar.asking: Asking the online main session on the side (side_question)
server-turns.sidecar.denied: The ask-only side thread is read-only: denied "{title}"
server-turns.sidecar.fallback: The side question got no answer: {why}; using a read-only side thread instead
server-turns.sidecar.hasFiles: the question has attachments (a side question takes text only)
server-turns.sidecar.mainOffline: the main AI is not online
server-turns.sidecar.mainStarting: the main AI process is still starting
server-turns.sidecar.noAnswer: the main session gave no answer
server-turns.sidecar.noDecline: The ask-only side thread is read-only: this request has no option to decline, so the turn was stopped
server-turns.sidecar.route.native: Ask · answered from the main context
server-turns.sidecar.toolRefusal: This is a {product} tool (daisy_*; harbor_* in conversations begun earlier) and cannot be used in an ask-only side thread. Read-only does not mean you cannot read: to read files, list directories or search, use your own commands directly (this side thread's sandbox allows reading, not writing).
server-turns.skill.outside: The skill directory is outside this identity
server-turns.skill.symlink: A skill file cannot be a symbolic link
server-turns.terminal.acpUnsupported: {short} has no full CLI that opens the same session (not supported)
server-turns.terminal.backlog: The terminal's output backlog went over the limit
server-turns.terminal.needChatgpt: This terminal needs a ChatGPT subscription identity; sign in first
server-turns.terminal.needSession: Start a native session by chatting first, then open the full CLI
server-turns.workspace.branch: · {branch} (from the committed version, without the original directory's uncommitted changes)
server-turns.worktree.branchChanged: The isolated workspace's branch changed; the owner should check it
server-turns.worktree.dirty: The original workspace has uncommitted changes; have its owner tidy them before creating an isolated collaborator
server-turns.worktree.noMainWorkspace: The main session's isolated workspace does not exist yet: an ask-only side thread has no workspace to read; send a plain @ instead
server-turns.worktree.rootSymlink: The isolated workspaces' root cannot be a symbolic link
server-turns.worktree.symlink: An isolated workspace cannot be a symbolic link
